facts.value: Another statistic is filling our hearts – we are seeing the most NEW players for a WoW launch in 15 years!
facts.context: Holly Longdale, Blizzard's executive producer and vice president for World of Warcraft, posted her own statistic, saying, "Another statistic is filling our hearts – we are seeing the most NEW players for a WoW launch in 15 years!" That means WoW Forever has brought more players in than any WoW expansion since Cataclysm first launched 16 years ago in 2010.
"Congratulations, everyone, you made history!" Blizzard writes in a recent social media post, thanking the community for making the launch such a success.
